sloka: दारयन् स च मां काकस्तत्रैव परिलीयते ।न चाप्युपारमन्मांसाद्भक्षार्थी बलिभोजनः ।। ५.३८.१६।।।।
transliteration: dārayan sa ca māṁ kākastatraiva parilīyate ।na cāpyupāramanmāṁsādbhakṣārthī balibhojanaḥ ।। 5.38.16।।।।

translations.english: 'The crow was an eater of offerings, hungry for food began to peck me again and again for flesh.He did not stop.
